annotations.title: Get one error event in full

description: One occurrence: frames with source lines and variables, request, tags, contexts, breadcrumbs, causes and trace id. Pass issue_id for its latest event, or event_id. Use it to see why one error happened. Long events give up variables, then library frames, then breadcrumbs, and `truncated` says what went: call again with section to read that part whole.

cursor.description: next_cursor, for frames, breadcrumbs and causes

event_id.description: Read this event, from search_error_events or get_error_issue

limit.description: Rows, for frames, breadcrumbs and causes (default 100)

section.description: Read one part whole instead of the whole event

name: get_error_event
title: Get one error event in full
